## F — Research index and VERIFY list: Revocation, suspension and driver improvement
Knowledge index: C.01 contains 41 original fact blocks; C2.01 contains 34 continuation fact blocks, all from this section’s mapped physical pages.
Authority and exam facts are located in A.01; audience in B.01; accuracy limits in D.01; demand and competitor gaps in E.01 and E2.01.
VERIFY list:
Accepted inventory: 41 C facts; 34 C2 facts; 8 typed debts; ids DE-PRIVILEGES-COUNT, DE-PRIVILEGES-PASS, DE-PRIVILEGES-TIME, DE-PRIVILEGES-CADENCE, DE-PRIVILEGES-COVER, DE-PRIVILEGES-RANGE, DE-PRIVILEGES-MARKET, DE-PRIVILEGES-TEARDOWN.
- DE-PRIVILEGES-COUNT: The handbook does not state the knowledge-test question count; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a count.
- DE-PRIVILEGES-PASS: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test passing percentage or passing score; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a threshold.
- DE-PRIVILEGES-TIME: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test time limit; do not substitute the road-exam duration.
- DE-PRIVILEGES-CADENCE: The snapshot is dated July on the front cover; the frequency of handbook revision was not independently verified.
- DE-PRIVILEGES-COVER: The extracted cover text carries the edition but not the graphical title or issuer; the issuer is established separately by frontmatter and the official linking page.
- DE-PRIVILEGES-RANGE: The point table upper bound printed as 15-l9 requires text/visual clarification before asserting that interval.
- DE-PRIVILEGES-MARKET: market pack requires sourced recon.
- DE-PRIVILEGES-TEARDOWN: competitive teardown requires sourced inspection.
Dynamic isolation: Contact details and mutable service/provider information remain outside stable facts; monetary and numerical rules are stated only as source-edition facts.
